text.p: 2Connect Express Inc, a specialty retailer of communications-related products, said Monday it has named Thomas Hicks as chief operating officer and chief financial officer.
Hicks was former chief operating officer of retailer Best Products Co, the company said.
Steve Stedman, vice president of finance, has resigned for personal reasons, it said.
2Connect said it also named Paul Simonson as chief accounting officer and Billy Fowler as vice president-store operations.
All three positions are newly created, said Marc Fishman, president and chief executive officer of the company.
Simonson was former assistant controller at Steiner Leisure Ltd while Fowler was former division vice president, south central region, at Office Max, it said.
